source_title: The Bible Is Not Chronology, It Is Cosmology
summary: This Civilization lecture becomes an earlier source-backed layer for Scripture, Identity, And Imperial Authorization by making the Bible a Davidic cosmology: not chronology, but a writing project that authorizes a poet-king, syncretizes gods and ancestors into Israel, and survives because the Yahwist turns political identity-making into living literature.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: The Bible is not a chronology; it is a cosmology built for legitimacy, cohesion, and differentiation.
existing_lens_links.rationale: The episode does not currently link any lens points, but this phrase directly reinforces the child lens point on crisis writing becoming durable sacred or literary inheritance.

existing_lens_links.episode_phrase: Yahweh as poet-god and David as poet-king make David's unconditional covenant look like the point where creation-through-words finds a political friend.
existing_lens_links.rationale: This is not an imperial-authorization case yet, but it strengthens the same crisis-writing mechanism: a sponsored text makes David's political problem inheritable as sacred literary order.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Treat the 2024-12-10 Yahwist lecture as the earlier Davidic-cosmology layer before the 2025 Literary Genesis and Dawn of the Jews sources: the Bible stops functioning as chronology and becomes a cosmology that gives David legitimacy, makes Israel through cohesion and differentiation, and shows why scripture can outlive court propaganda.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: The child lens owns this when sacred writing turns a crisis or heterogeneous population into inheritable identity. The Legitimacy Fiction parent owns the broader inheritance rule; Stories owns narrative world-setting when political identity is not the active object.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use the syncretization sequence as the child page's identity-construction evidence: conquered or merged peoples marry gods, merge ancestors into family relations, absorb Egyptian priestly practice through Moses and temple sacrifice, and differentiate themselves by narrated wars against those they must not be.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Nation As God-Machine owns the later sacred collective body when the national person is primary. This source belongs first to Scripture Identity because the mechanism is written family, gods, priests, and enemy-memory making Israel legible.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: If Poetry needs another Bible layer, use Yahweh as poet-god and creation as spoken editing: words make a world, judge it, revise it, and teach later readers that reality can be constructed through language.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Poetry owns the medium and world-making force of language. Scripture Identity owns the political identity work; Legitimacy Fiction owns the inherited rightfulness produced by that work.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold the Yahwist's economy, irony, family drama, and readerly co-creation as possible evidence for how sparse literary characters become psychologically alive enough for readers to keep generating meaning.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Fictional Heroes owns the readerly co-creation and psychologically alive characters only if the public page needs literary-personhood evidence; do not move the whole Bible-cosmology mechanism there.

new_lens_seeds.title: Poet-God And Poet-King
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A ruler becomes legitimate when the sacred order is written as the same kind of being: Yahweh creates and edits reality through words, while David's poetry makes his political ambition look like friendship with the creator rather than usurpation.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism may recur across poetry, scripture, and political authorization sources, but it currently fits inside Scripture Identity, Legitimacy Fiction, and Poetry without requiring a standalone page.

new_lens_seeds.title: Yahwist Literature Makes Propaganda Live
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A sponsored identity text escapes ordinary propaganda when literary economy, irony, domestic comedy, fallible divinity, and reader co-creation make the story spiritually and psychologically inexhaustible.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: This is a strong literary mechanism, but it should stay a held seed until compared with Homer, Dante, Virgil, David, and later Literary Genesis sources; the current public pages can carry it as Scripture Identity and Fictional Heroes evidence.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2024-12-10, this lecture sits between the David apology source and the Cyrus source, making it an earlier formulation of the Bible-as-cosmology and Yahwist-literature layer now partially carried by the later 2025 Literary Genesis and Dawn of the Jews public sections.
The Yahwist-authorship claim is useful but speculative: preserve Jiang's daughter/granddaughter-of-David hypothesis as attributed pressure, not settled canon.

next_actions.action: Do not create standalone Bible Cosmology, Yahwist, Poet-God, Poet-King, Syncretized Israel, or God Learns pages from this source alone; the pressure belongs inside existing Scripture Identity, Poetry, Fictional Heroes, Legitimacy Fiction, Nation, and Human Heart boundaries.
